chunks: 5158 - Abān narrated from Abū Isḥāq Ibrāhīm al-Ṣayqal, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said to me:
A scroll was found in the hilt of the sword of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, and in it was written:
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

Indeed, the most rebellious of people against Allah on the Day of Resurrection is one who kills someone other than his killer, strikes someone other than the one who struck him, and whoever takes as guardian other than his rightful guardians is a disbeliever in what Allah sent down upon Muḥammad. And whoever innovates a grave offense or gives shelter to an offender, Allah, Exalted is He, will not accept from him on the Day of Resurrection any compensation nor ransom.

He said: Then he said, “Do you know what is meant by his saying, ‘whoever takes as guardian other than his rightful guardians’?” I said, “What does it mean?” He said, “It means the people of the religion.”

key_terms.آوَى مُحْدِثاً: gave refuge or protection to an offender
key_terms.أَحْدَثَ حَدَثاً: committed a serious offense or introduced a punishable violation
key_terms.أَعْتَى النَّاسِ: the most defiant or rebellious of people before Allah
key_terms.ذُؤَابَةِ سَيْفِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the hilt or upper part of the sword of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله where the scroll was found
key_terms.صَرْفاً وَ لَا عَدْلًا: neither compensation nor ransom will be accepted
key_terms.كَافِرٌ بِمَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَى مُح: a repudiation framed as disbelief in what Allah revealed to Muḥammad
key_terms.مَنْ تَوَلَّى غَيْرَ مَوَالِيهِ: one who gives allegiance or loyalty to other than his rightful guardians
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Resurrection when final judgment occurs

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith about the scroll in the sword of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله teach about unlawful killing, false allegiance, and sheltering offenders?
ai.summary: This hadith records a written statement found in the sword of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله condemning unlawful retaliation, wrongful violence, false allegiance, and protecting offenders. It warns that such acts are among the gravest forms of rebellion against Allah on the Day of Resurrection, and it clarifies that rightful allegiance pertains to the people of the religion.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.5158 - Aban narrated from Abu Ishaq Ibrahim Al-Sayqal, who said:
Abu Abdullah (as) said to me: "
A scroll was found in the hilt of the sword of Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family), and it was written in it:
In the Name of Allah (swt), the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
Verily, the most defiant of people against Allah (swt) on the Day of Judgment is the one who kills someone other than his killer, strikes someone other than the one who struck him, and whoever aligns himself with other than his rightful guardians is a disbeliever in what Allah (swt) revealed to Muhammad (sw).
And whoever commits an offense or shelters an offender, Allah (swt) the Exalted will not accept from him any repentance or compensation on the Day of Judgment."
Imam (as) then said: "Do you know what is meant by the saying 'whoever aligns himself with other than his rightful guardians'?"
I asked: "What does it mean?"
Imam (as) replied: "It means the people of the religion."
